title: Crunchyroll’s Biggest Action Fantasy Returns With a Surprise Isekai Crossover Ahead of Season 3
content: Wistoria: Wand and Sword is easily the hottest action fantasy on Crunchyroll right now, but fans will have to wait a while before the third season. Thanks to the popularity of the anime, a season 3 was confirmed right along with the second season finale in June this year.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Wareware wa Uchuujin' Announces Additional Cast
content: The official website of the Wareware wa Uchuujin ( We Are Aliens ) announced additional cast on Thursday. The film is scheduled to premiere in Japanese theaters on September 25.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Live-Action S and X: Confession of Therapist Series Streams 1st 2 Minutes
content: Netflix began streaming the first two minutes from the live-action series of Kisei Tada 's S and X: Confession of Therapist ( S to X ~Therapist Shimotori Ichito no Kokuhaku) manga for free on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: Ayano Yamane's The Husky and His White Cat Shizun Manga Adaptation Suspended
content: Manga artist Ayano Yamane announced on Wednesday that she has withdrawn from the manga adaptation of Rou Bao Bu Chi Rou's The Husky and His White Cat Shizun: Erha He Ta De Bai Mao Shizun novel series.

title: Disney Twisted-Wonderland Anime's New Teaser Announces Fairouz Ai as Yuuka
content: Disney+ presented the teaser promotional video for Episode of Savanaclaw , the second season for the Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation series , on Thursday. The teaser introduces Fairouz Ai as the voice of Yuuka Hirasaka, a high school student who excels at judo and the protagonist of the second season.
author: ANN

title: Disney Twisted-Wonderland Season 2 Reveals Teaser Trailer, Fairouz Ai Joins Voice Cast
content: Disney Twisted-Wonderland: The Animation revealed a teaser trailer for its second season, Episode of Savanaclaw , which will stream exclusively on Disney+ beginning in December 2026. Fairouz Ai has also joined the cast as Yuga Hirasaka.
author: Anime Corner

title: BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA Reveals Episode 10 Preview
content: BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA revealed the preview for Episode 10, titled “Sea”. Takumi Miyata ( Narenare: Cheer for you! ) is directing the episode with the script written by Tomomi Hitomi Ogawa ( The Apothecary Diaries ) and storyboard done by Tomomi Umetsu ( Food for the Soul ).
author: Anime Corner

title: 3 Compelling Reasons to Rewatch Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Now That It’s on Crunchyroll & Netflix
content: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle is now streaming on Crunchyroll and Netflix (in select regions), which means those who missed the film’s theatrical run can finally dive in. Of course, subscribers who have already seen the movie can also revisit it from the comfort of their own homes.
author: ComicBook

title: Re:ZERO Season 4 Director Reveals Unblurred Image of Rem Scene From Episode 13
content: Re:ZERO Season 4 director Masahiro Shinohara revealed an original version of a scene from Episode 13 , featuring an unblurred image of Rem. The scene was shown on August 19 in the episode titled “Stand Up,” and Subaru’s tears were the reason for the initial blurriness.
author: Anime Corner
